title: How do I know if my child is ready for Occupational Therapy?
metaTitle: Is My Child Ready for Occupational Therapy? - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we help you understand if your child can benefit from Occupational Therapy through an initial comprehensive assessment.
html: Understanding if your child is ready for Occupational Therapy can often be challenging. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we believe that if your child faces complications in performing daily tasks like feeding or dressing themselves, or is having a hard time socializing with peers, they might leverage from Occupational Therapy. We provide an initial comprehensive evaluation to ascertain if your child can benefit from the therapy.
